basis.note: G4A rows carry raw PLANNER_BUDGET strings (addendum A2): an upper-side proxy for slow target searches

notes: max_motion_nodes 4000 is the unchanged planner profile (semantic consistency), not new effort
roots are already constructed geometrically in this plan; no construction attempt at collection time
one worker: the tested guard/runner (g4d_run.run_collection) is single-worker
aggregate = high estimate x 1.1 rounded up to 30 min of CPU; wall = aggregate x 1.25

pilot.rule: first root of J0, J2, J3, J4, J9; pilot roots stay inside the 20-root development set; pilot outcomes never retune or replace other roots
